DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談先とは画面がつながりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nakakonekta na po ba ang video sa konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面は見えますが、相手の声が聞こえません。こちらの声は届いているそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: オンライン相談で映像は見えるが相手の声が聞こえないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakikita ang larawan pero hindi ko marinig ang kausap. Naririnig naman daw niya ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nakikita ang online consultation ngunit hindi marinig ang kausap. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机のヘッドセットをお使いですね。音量のつまみを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Headset sa mesa ang gamit ninyo. Titingnan ko ang pihitan ng volume.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: つまみが一番小さくなっています。少し上げてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ヘッドセット音量の低さに気づき調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nasa pinakamahina ang pihitan. Lakasan ko nang kaunti.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mapansin ang mahinang volume ng headset at ayusin. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置で、相手の方へ声を出していただきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa puwestong iyan, pasalitain natin ang kausap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は聞こえます。大きすぎない音になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 聞こえる適切な音量になったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naririnig ko na. Tamang lakas na at hindi sobra.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing naririnig na sa angkop na lakas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: よかったです。相談の資料は、こちらの書類カメラで見せられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mabuti. Maipapakita ang mga dokumento sa document camera na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一枚を見せたいです。紙を横向きに置くと全部映りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類カメラへ資料を横向きに置く方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong ipakita ang isang papel na ito. Kung pahiga ang papel, makikita ang kabuuan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pahigang paglalagay ng dokumento sa camera. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、横にすると収まります。画面で文字の向きも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo, kasya kung pahiga. Tiyakin din ang direksiyon ng sulat sa screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体が映っています。音も資料も大丈夫なので、このまま相談を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料全体と音を確認し相談を開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kita ang kabuuan. Ayos ang tunog at dokumento, kaya sisimulan ko ang konsultasyon nang ganito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang buong dokumento at tunog at simulan ang konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、職員は退室します。終わりましたら呼出しをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Lalabas na po ang kawani. Pakitawag kami kapag natapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院後の説明で、気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May ikinababahala sa tagubilin pagkatapos lumabas ng ospital?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬は昼食後と書いてありますが、仕事の日は昼食が二時になります。時刻をどうしたらいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼食後服薬と仕事日の二時昼食の関係を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakasulat na gamot pagkatapos ng tanghalian, pero alas-dos ang tanghalian ko sa araw ng trabaho. Ano ang gagawin sa oras?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang gamot pagkatapos ng tanghalian at alas-dos na tanghalian sa araw ng trabaho. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 薬の種類を確認して、薬剤師へおつなぎします。普段の食事の時刻も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titingnan ko ang uri ng gamot at iuugnay sa parmasyutiko. Itatanong din ang karaniwang oras ng pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝は七時、夜は八時です。休みの日の昼食は十二時です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝夜と休日昼食の時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Alas-siyete sa umaga at alas-otso sa gabi. Alas-dose ang tanghalian sa araw ng pahinga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang umaga, gabi, at tanghalian sa araw ng pahinga. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 仕事の日と休みの日で昼食の時刻が違うのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaiba pala ang oras ng tanghalian sa trabaho at araw ng pahinga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。朝の薬と近くなるか心配なので、自分で昼の薬を朝へ移すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己変更せず朝薬との間隔を心配していると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Baka mapalapit sa gamot sa umaga, kaya hindi ko balak ilipat ang gamot sa tanghali sa umaga nang mag-isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi babaguhin mag-isa at nag-aalala sa pagitan mula gamot sa umaga. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのご心配も伝えます。説明のメモに、二通りの生活時間を書きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipaparating ko rin ang alalahanin. Isulat natin ang dalawang iskedyul sa tala ng tagubilin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この余白に「仕事の日、昼食二時」と書きます。休みの日は十二時と書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事日休日の二つの昼食時刻をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa bakanteng ito isusulat kong “araw ng trabaho, tanghalian alas-dos”. Sa pahinga ay alas-dose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Isulat ang dalawang oras ng tanghalian sa trabaho at pahinga. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 薬剤師が今こちらへ来ますので、そのメモをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Papunta na rito ang parmasyutiko, kaya ipakita ang tala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。説明を聞いたら、飲む時刻をメモへ追加して持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬剤師説明後に服薬時刻を追記して持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Pagkatapos ng paliwanag, idaragdag ko ang oras ng gamot sa tala at iuuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pagkatapos ng paliwanag ng parmasyutiko, idagdag ang oras ng gamot at iuwi. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この席でご相談ください。退院準備でお疲れのところ、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito po sa upuan kumonsulta. Paumanhin habang pagod kayo sa paghahanda ng paglabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 請求のメールを受け取ったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nakatanggap po kayo ng email na naniningil, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。注文していない商品について、今日中に払うよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未注文商品の当日支払請求メールを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nakasulat na magbayad ngayong araw para sa produktong hindi ko inorder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang email na naniningil ngayong araw sa hindi inorder na produkto. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールの中のリンクを開いたり、支払ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nabuksan ba ang link o nakapagbayad na?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。送信元の名前は、以前使った店と似ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンク未開封支払なしと似た送信者名を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Wala pa pareho. Kahawig ng dati kong tindahan ang pangalan ng nagpadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nabuksan ang link, walang bayad, at kahawig ang pangalan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受信した画面と、文面を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Maipapakita ang screen ng natanggap at ang mensahe?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。注文番号はありますが、その番号の注文は自分の購入履歴にありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メールを見せ購入履歴に該当注文がないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Heto. May order number pero wala sa purchase history ko ang order na iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang email at kawalan ng katumbas na order sa history. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 添付ファイルは開いていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開いていません。店の正規の問い合わせ先へ確認する前に、相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 添付未開封と正規連絡先への確認前の相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi. Kumonsulta ako bago tiyakin sa opisyal na kontak ng tindahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi binuksan ang attachment at kumokonsulta bago ang opisyal na kontak. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送信元やリンク先は、専門の担当が確認します。文面は残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Susuriin ng espesyalistang kawani ang sender at link. Panatilihin ang teksto ng mensahe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 消さずに残します。追加でメールが来たら、同じ画面と受信時刻を記録しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メール保存と追加受信時刻記録を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ko buburahin. Kung may dagdag na email, itatala ko ang parehong screen at oras ng pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang itabi ang email at itala ang oras ng karagdagang pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ituturo ko ang kawani. Salamat sa pagkonsulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ポストへの投函についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa paghuhulog sa postbox?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日中に出したい手紙ですが、表のポストは最後の集荷が終わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日差出し希望とポスト最終集荷後かを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Gusto kong ipadala ang sulat ngayong araw. Tapos na ba ang huling koleksiyon sa postbox sa labas?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong ipadala ngayon at itanong kung tapos ang huling koleksiyon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はそのポストの集荷は終わりました。窓口はまだ受け付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tapos na ngayong araw ang koleksiyon doon. Tumatanggap pa ang counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、窓口へ出します。貼った切手のままで預かってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口差出しへ変え貼付切手の利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa counter ko ibibigay. Maaari bang tanggapin nang nakakabit ang dati nang selyo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Lumipat sa counter at tiyakin ang paggamit ng nakakabit na selyo. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重さと料金を確認します。こちらの切手で足りています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ang timbang at singil. Sapat ang selyong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かりました。今日受け付けてもらえれば、明日必ず着くということではありませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日受付と翌日到着の違いを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Malaking tulong. Hindi naman ibig sabihing siguradong bukas darating kapag tinanggap ngayon, ano?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagkakaiba ng pagtanggap ngayon at pagdating bukas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、到着日は別にご案内します。お急ぎの内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo, hiwalay na ipapaliwanag ang araw ng pagdating. Madalian ba ang laman?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急ぎではありません。出し忘れないよう、今日のうちに差し出したかっただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 急ぎではなく出し忘れ防止の当日差出しと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi madalian. Gusto ko lang ipadala ngayon para hindi makalimutan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi madalian at pagpapadala ngayon para hindi makalimutan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでしたら、普通の送り方でお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung gayon, tatanggapin sa karaniwang paraan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。同行者には、窓口へ出したので外のポストには入れないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 普通扱いを依頼し同行者へ投函不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Sasabihin ko sa kasama na naibigay sa counter, kaya hindi ihuhulog sa labas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng karaniwang pagpapadala at sabihin sa kasama na hindi na ihuhulog. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。ありがとうございました。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の番号を確認されたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gusto po ninyong tiyakin ang numero sa pila?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。札をかばんに入れたはずですが、見つかりません。もう一枚取るべきでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 番号札不明で再発行すべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Akala ko inilagay sa bag pero hindi makita. Dapat bang kumuha ng isa pa?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung kukuha muli kapag nawawala ang numero. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お取りになった時刻と、用件を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Anong oras kinuha at ano ang pakay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時ごろです。通帳の繰越しを選びました。番号は八十六だったと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十時の通帳繰越しと推定八十六番を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mga alas-diyes. Pinili ko ang pagpapalit ng punong passbook. Sa tingin ko otsenta y sais ang numero.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagpapalit ng passbook nang alas-diyes at tinatayang otsenta y sais. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の受付記録には、その時刻に八十六番があります。お名前では管理していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: May otsenta y sais sa oras na iyon sa rekord. Hindi sa pangalan pinamamahalaan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今呼ばれているのは八十四番ですね。二枚取らず、元の順番で待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在八十四番と元の順番を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Otsenta y kuwatro ang tinatawag ngayon, ano? Gusto kong sa dating pila maghintay nang hindi kumukuha ng dalawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kasalukuyang otsenta y kuwatro at hilingin ang dating pila. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次に八十六番を呼ぶ時、窓口でお話を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kapag tinawag ang otsenta y sais, titiyakin namin sa counter ang sinabi ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。通帳は手元にあります。窓口で、札がないことを先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通帳を持ち札紛失を窓口で伝えると了承する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Dala ang passbook. Sasabihin ko muna sa counter na walang slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sumang-ayong dalhin ang passbook at sabihin sa counter ang nawawalang slip. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: あ、かばんの横のポケットに紙が見えていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: May papel na nakikita sa bulsa sa gilid ng bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありました、八十六番です。札を持って、表示が変わるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 横ポケットの八十六番を見つけ番号表示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nakita ko, otsenta y sais. Hawak ko ang slip at maghihintay magbago ang display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Makita ang otsenta y sais sa bulsa sa gilid at hintayin ang display. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。お呼びするまでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Mabuting nahanap. Maghintay hanggang tawagin. Paalam po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卵のパックが開いてしまいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nabuksan po ang pakete ng itlog?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かごへ入れた時、ふたの留める所が外れました。卵は落ちていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かご入れ時に卵パック留め具が外れ落下なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Paglagay sa basket natanggal ang pangkabit ng takip. Hindi nahulog ang itlog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing natanggal ang pangkabit sa paglagay sa basket at walang nahulog. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 卵の状態を確認します。割れている物は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titingnan ko ang mga itlog. Walang mukhang basag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そのまま買いたいですが、持って歩くとまた開きそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ卵購入を希望し再開封を心配する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Gusto kong bilhin pa rin ang mga ito, pero baka mabuksan muli habang dinadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling na bilhin ang parehong itlog at mag-alala sa muling pagbukas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 留め直して、こちらの紙帯を巻きます。袋へ入れる前に位置を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ikakabit muli at babalutan ng paper band. Tingnan ang posisyon bago ilagay sa bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帯がふたを押さえていますね。値段の表示も見えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙帯の固定と価格表示を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hawak ng band ang takip. Kita rin ang presyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang paghawak ng band at display ng presyo. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この状態で会計できます。ほかに重い商品はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring bayaran nang ganito. May iba pang mabigat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 牛乳を買います。卵とは別の手提げに入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 牛乳と卵を別手提げへ分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bibili ng gatas. Gusto kong hiwalay ang bag nito sa itlog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing magkahiwalay na bag ang gatas at itlog. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙帯は会計後も付けたままでお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Panatilihin ang paper band matapos magbayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。卵用の小さい手提げを出し、牛乳は大きい方へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帯を残し小袋へ卵大袋へ牛乳を入れる準備をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ilalabas ang maliit na bag para sa itlog at sa malaki ang gatas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iwan ang band at maghanda ng maliit na bag sa itlog at malaki sa gatas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのままレジへお進みください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dumiretso sa cashier nang ganyan. Salamat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 足こぎカートをご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。座ってみましたが、ペダルの一番遠い所へ足が届きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 足こぎカートのペダルに足が届かないと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Umupo ako pero hindi abot ng paa ang pedal sa pinakamalayong punto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi abot ng paa ang pedal cart. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 座席を一段前へ動かします。一度降りていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iuusog ko ang upuan nang isang hakbang pasulong. Maaari bang bumaba muna?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 降りました。荷物も横の台へ置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座席調整のため降り荷物を台へ置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bumaba na. Ilalagay rin ang gamit sa katabing mesa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Bumaba para sa pag-ayos ng upuan at ilagay ang gamit sa mesa. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 固定しました。もう一度座り、止まったままでペダルを回してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Naka-lock na. Umupo muli at paikutin ang pedal habang nakahinto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は届きます。膝もハンドルに当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 調整後の到達と膝の接触なしを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Abot na. Hindi rin tumatama ang tuhod sa manibela.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing abot na at hindi tumatama ang tuhod pagkatapos ayusin. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、ブレーキをかける動作も試してください。このレバーです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Subukan din ang pagpreno. Itong pingga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 握ると車輪が止まりますね。走る前に、コースの向きも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 停止中にブレーキ操作を試しコース方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hihinto ang gulong kapag pinisil. Bago umandar, gusto ko ring itanong ang direksiyon ng kurso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Subukan ang preno habang nakahinto at itanong ang direksiyon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口から左回りです。一周したら、この停止線の前で止まってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakaliwa ang ikot mula sa pasukan. Pagkatapos ng isang ikot, huminto bago ang linyang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左回りで一周し、線の前でブレーキをかけます。この座席位置で始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左回り一周と停止線前の制動を確認して開始する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Iikot ako pakaliwa nang isang beses at magpreno bago linya. Magsisimula sa puwestong ito ng upuan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang isang ikot pakaliwa at pagpreno bago linya saka magsimula. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ゆっくりお進みください。楽しんでくださいね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の列車は運休になりました。指定券をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kinansela ang susunod na tren. May tiket ng reserved seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。座席を予約してありますが、この券はどうすればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指定券の運休時の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Nakareserba ang upuan. Ano ang gagawin sa tiket na ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paghawak sa reserved ticket kapag kanselado ang tren. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更か払い戻しを、窓口でご相談いただけます。今日中に移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Makokonsulta ang pagbabago o refund sa counter. Bibiyahe pa ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は取りやめます。乗車券と指定席の券が別ですが、両方持って行きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旅行を取りやめ二種類の券の持参を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko na itutuloy ang biyahe ngayon. Hiwalay ang tiket sa biyahe at reserved seat; pareho bang dadalhin?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kanselahin ang biyahe at itanong ang dalawang uri ng tiket. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、両方お持ちください。お支払いはカードでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo, dalhin pareho. Card ba ang bayad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードです。使ったカードも鞄にあります。窓口は改札の外ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード払いを伝え窓口の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Card. Nasa bag rin ang ginamit na card. Nasa labas ng gate ang counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing card ang bayad at itanong ang lokasyon ng counter. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外の右側です。まだ改札には入っていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa labas sa kanan. Hindi pa pumasok sa gate, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、入っていません。同行者の券も私がまとめて買ったので、一緒に持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札未入場と同行者分の購入を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo, hindi pa. Ako rin ang sabay bumili ng tiket ng kasama kaya dadalhin din.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi pa pumasok at binili rin ang tiket ng kasama. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入した際の控えがあれば、それもご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kung may patunay sa pagbili, ihanda rin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布に控えがありました。券二人分とカード、控えを持って右の窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券とカードと控えを揃え窓口へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nakita ko sa pitaka. Dadalhin ang tiket ng dalawang tao, card, at patunay sa counter sa kanan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tipunin ang tiket, card, at patunay at pumunta sa counter. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの通路からどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談予約の受付です。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Desk po ito para sa reserbasyong konsultasyon. Anong paksa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸住宅のことで相談したいです。難しい話になるので、通訳もお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅相談で通訳を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tungkol sa inuupahang bahay. Mahirap na usapan kaya maaari ring humiling ng interpreter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng interpreter para sa konsultasyon sa pabahay. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対応できる言語と日程を担当に確認します。何語をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titingnan ang wika at iskedyul sa kawani. Anong wika ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。仕事が休みの水曜午後なら来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 言語と来庁可能日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. Maaari ako sa Miyerkules ng hapon dahil pahinga sa trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang wika at oras na makakapunta sa opisina. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 水曜午後の希望で照会します。相談の資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itatanong ang Miyerkules ng hapon. May dokumento para sa konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約書と、大家さんから届いた手紙があります。先に写しを送った方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を説明し事前送付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kontrata at liham mula sa landlord. Dapat bang ipadala muna ang kopya?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang dokumento at itanong ang paunang pagpapadala. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約担当が送付方法をお伝えします。折り返し先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng kawani ng reserbasyon ang pagpapadala. Ibigay ang numerong tatawagan muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この携帯番号です。午前中は出られないので、午後三時以降にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 折り返し番号と連絡可能時間を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong mobile number. Hindi makakasagot sa umaga, kaya pagkatapos ng alas-tres ng hapon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang callback number at oras na makokontak. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 午後三時以降の連絡と記録しました。日程は折り返しの時に決まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naitala ang pagkatapos ng alas-tres. Sa callback pa magpapasiya ng iskedyul.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ予約確定ではないのですね。連絡を受けてから、契約書を用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約未確定を理解し資料準備を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi pa pala kumpirmado. Pagkatanggap ng tawag saka ihahanda ang kontrata.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi pa kumpirmado at magpasiyang maghanda ng dokumento. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ取り次ぎます。お電話ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipaparating sa kawani. Salamat sa pagtawag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院の書類はそろいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kumpleto na po ang mga dokumento ng paglabas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この紙の入浴の欄に丸が二つあって、どちらなのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 退院書類の入浴欄の不明点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Pero dalawang bilog ang nasa paliguan sa papel at hindi ko alam kung alin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang hindi malinaw sa bahagi ng pagligo sa discharge paper. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一緒に拝見します。シャワーと浴槽の欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan natin. Shower at bathtub na mga puwang, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日からシャワーだけよいという意味ですか。傷があるので、聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: シャワーの可否を担当へ再確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ibig bang sabihin shower lang mula ngayon? May sugat kaya gusto kong magtanong muli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling na muling tiyakin sa kinauukulang kawani ang pahintulot sa shower. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当の看護師に記載を確認します。少しこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin sa nars na namamahala ang nakasulat. Maghintay sandali rito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。説明の時、着替えの際に傷をぬらした場合も聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傷をぬらした場合の相談を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Sa paliwanag, maaari ring itanong kapag nabasa ang sugat habang nagpapalit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magdagdag ng tanong tungkol sa nabasang sugat. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その点も伝えます。担当が今こちらへ来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Opo, ipaparating din. Papunta na rito ang kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅に浴槽しかなくて、どう洗えばよいかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅の入浴設備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bathtub lang ang nasa bahay, kaya gusto ko ring itanong kung paano maghuhugas ng katawan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang paliguan sa bahay. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その事情も直接お話しください。指示が決まったら紙へ追記してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin din nang diretso ang sitwasyon. Kapag malinaw ang tagubilin, ipasulat natin sa papel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。自己判断で入浴せず、担当の説明を聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の指示を聞いてから帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Hindi ako maliligo sa sariling pasya at uuwi matapos marinig ang paliwanag ng kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang marinig ang tagubilin bago umuwi. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞこちらのお席へ。退院後もお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Dito po umupo. Ingatan ang sarili matapos lumabas ng ospital.
